description: Core capability for the main EEF Dashboard window. Grants only Tauri's default core permissions (window, webview, event, path, app). The frontend is a self-contained client-side app served over Tauri's asset protocol, so no extra plugin permissions are required for the beta. When the auto-updater is wired in a later phase, add `updater:default` and `process:default` here (see ../MIGRATION_NOTES.md).
